directorStyles.name: David Fincher — Control Clínico & Precisión
directorStyles.fluxPromptTokens: David Fincher aesthetic, Jeff Cronenweth clinical cinematography, razor-sharp focus on iris, clean symmetrical composition, deep controlled shadows with subtle cyan-amber color separation, negative fill contrast, Hasselblad crispness
directorStyles.motionPromptStyle: Calculated precision mechanical dolly push-in, zero handheld jitter, steady hypnotic eye lock

directorStyles.name: Wong Kar-wai — Seducción Nocturna & Neón Clandestino
directorStyles.fluxPromptTokens: Wong Kar-wai and Christopher Doyle cinematography, lush sensual 35mm anamorphic bokeh, rich emerald and crimson neon practical glow, soft foreground framing blur, poetic nocturnal Hong Kong speakeasy mood, 35mm film grain texture
directorStyles.motionPromptStyle: Languid drifting lateral glide, soft candle and neon shimmer, dreamy slow tempo

directorStyles.name: Denis Villeneuve — Monumentalidad & Luz Motivada Única
directorStyles.fluxPromptTokens: Roger Deakins and Denis Villeneuve cinematography, monumental architectural symmetry, single motivated natural light source casting clean geometric shadows, delicate atmospheric mist, tactile basalt stone and water reflections
directorStyles.motionPromptStyle: Solemn slow architectural pedestal rise, serene minimal subject motion, meditative stillness

directorStyles.name: Luca Guadagnino — Sensorialidad Táctil & Luz Mediterránea
directorStyles.fluxPromptTokens: Luca Guadagnino and Sayombhu Mukdeeprom 35mm Kodak Portra aesthetic, warm Mediterranean side-window daylight, tactile marble copper and linen textures, intimate unhurried sensual realism, golden warm skin bounce
directorStyles.motionPromptStyle: Gentle organic push-in and tactile macro slider glide, relaxed natural breathing

directorStyles.name: Stanley Kubrick — Simetría Hipnótica & Luz de Velas
directorStyles.fluxPromptTokens: Stanley Kubrick and John Alcott Barry Lyndon candlelight aesthetic, one-point perspective symmetry, subtle low-angle dominance, ultra-fast f/1.4 practical 2200K flickering candlelight, rich chiaroscuro velvet and brass
directorStyles.motionPromptStyle: Hypnotic locked symmetrical forward tracking glide, commanding stationary posture

directorStyles.name: Emmanuel Lubezki — Inmersión Fluida & Contraluz Natural
directorStyles.fluxPromptTokens: Emmanuel Lubezki wide-angle 24mm immersive proximity, natural golden or streetlamp rim backlight catching copper red hair strands, realistic environmental depth, candid living movement, sharp foreground subject
directorStyles.motionPromptStyle: Fluid 1.7Hz handheld walking presence, gentle parallax wrap, strict 3.0s clip limit

directorStyles.name: Nicolas Winding Refn — Neon Noir & Contraste Cromático
directorStyles.fluxPromptTokens: Nicolas Winding Refn neon noir cinematography, sculptural magenta and cyan split lighting, specular reflections on black marble, bold geometric framing, magnetic hypnotic poise
directorStyles.motionPromptStyle: Locked vertical tripod or ultra-slow push-in, rhythmic center-of-mass stability, feet anchored

directorStyles.name: Sofia Coppola — Intimidad Suave & Susurro Editorial
directorStyles.fluxPromptTokens: Sofia Coppola and Philippe Le Sourd delicate editorial portrait, soft diffused window light, creamy 85mm f/1.4 shallow depth of field, intimate serene vulnerability, refined porcelain and silk atmosphere
directorStyles.motionPromptStyle: Whisper-quiet slow push-in or gentle rack focus from reflection/prop to emerald eyes
